name: @agentic-toolkit/api-explorer
description: Reusable, authed "try-it-out" endpoint panel for agentic-web-toolkit consumers — spec-generated endpoint metadata plus a theme-aware React panel that documents one REST endpoint (URL, params, request/response schemas, errors, CRUD-family siblings) and calls it with the logged-in user's credentials.
comment:exports: `development` → src for `next dev` (HMR, no build/restart); prod skips it → dist. Mirrors the @agentic-toolkit/ui + @agentic-toolkit/auth convention. `./generated/endpoints.generated` is a deliberate subpath export kept OFF the main barrel (see src/index.ts) — it exists only so the monorepo's drift test (websites/shared/api-explorer's src/__tests__/endpoints.test.ts, which stays monorepo-side to read openapi.json) can import the generated maps directly.
